notes: A procedural solar tidal-disruption event around a 300,000-solar-mass non-spinning Schwarzschild black hole.
The solar center follows a fixed-step RK4 timelike Schwarzschild geodesic with E=1 and L=3.98M, producing a physical near-critical zoom-whirl capture without fictitious drag.
Horizon, photon sphere, ISCO, critical shadow impact, tidal radius, redshift, Doppler beaming and local speed all share one GM/c^2 unit system.
A TSL post compositor captures subcritical rays and blends strong- and weak-deflection Schwarzschild bending around the exact 3sqrt(3)M shadow boundary.
Procedural HDR photosphere, corona, prominences, dual tidal streams, debris knots, relativistic disk, polar outflow, stars and galactic dust require no downloaded assets.
The stellar envelope and debris field are deterministic real-time Roche/frozen-in approximations rather than a general-relativistic magnetohydrodynamics solve.
The world, camera-attached GPU HUD, lensing and bloom resolve through exactly one final render call and one swap-chain presentation per animation tick.
A committed 72-second stereo PCM score is deterministically generated from the same geodesic, gravitational-redshift and Roche-stress timeline and stays muted until M enables it.
ACES tone mapping and emissive bloom retain a construction-time direct HDR fallback; an in-flight post failure stops the renderer rather than reusing an acquired swap-chain texture.
Reflex Boost is requested only when supported, while DLSS SR, Frame Generation and Ray Reconstruction remain disabled.
A toggles the cinematic camera; 1-3 select shots; drag orbits; the wheel dollies; Space pauses; T changes speed; X compares lensing; M toggles sonification; R restarts; H toggles the in-canvas HUD.
